items.title: New electricity price takes effect
items.quote: aufgrund gestiegener Netzentgelte und Beschaffungskosten passen wir unsere Preise zum 01.01.2026 an:
items.computation: The letter states the new prices apply from 01.01.2026. This is a fixed calendar date printed in the letter, so no further counting is needed.

items.title: Special termination (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) to avoid the new price
items.quote: Sie haben das Recht, Ihren Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Preisänderung zu kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to terminate without notice period, effective at the moment the price increase takes effect (01.01.2026), but does not print an explicit last day to send the cancellation. To end the contract exactly at that effective date (i.e. before the higher price applies), the termination notice must reach the provider on the last day of the old term, one day before 01.01.2026: 31.12.2025 (a Wednesday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). Sending it later would mean the new price already applies for at least part of the period before termination takes effect.

warnings: The letter does not print an explicit last day for the special termination right; the 31.12.2025 deadline is inferred as the day before the price increase takes effect, not a date stated verbatim in the letter.

The letter's own IBAN (DE81 3705 0198 0002 3456 78, Musterbank AG) checks out as structurally valid, but this only confirms the IBAN's format, not that it truly belongs to Beispiel Energie AG — compare it with a previous, independently verified bill before making any payment to it.
